title: Implement age bounds and replay rejection
acceptance: Clock uncertainty or request lineage bounds capture age; reject duplicate/reordered/wrong-session messages.
evidence: backend/freshness.py: stateful final-consumer clock/lineage capture-age gate; fixed observation deadlines, bounded health, nonce consumption, replay/epoch checks and independent local expiry.
backend/events_client.py: certificate-verified native WSS consumer against accepted CS-029 pairing; defaults to unavailable when joint clock drift is unverified.

57 backend tests passed locally on Windows Python 3.14.3, including 21 new freshness cases and real WSS calibration/fresh-versus-stale reception. Legacy replay passed. See handoffs/CS-030-capture-age-20261017.md; no actual device drift, hardware or edge-policy integration acceptance claimed.
